options.content:
# Path Analytics Ingestion Pipeline

Top-down view of the Path Analytics ingestion pipeline. Data flows from Path Analytics → RA Collector → Sensor Collector (Roadrunner) → Fedex → Kafka → Sky-Topo → Gather → Druid.

**How to triage a data outage:** read the Pipeline Flow Summary left-to-right — the first stage showing **red (0)** is where data stopped. Expand that service's row for detailed panels.

**Note:** Path Analytics data does NOT flow through Ignite or Spark. Fedex writes to `skytopo_raw_in.*` Kafka topics, consumed directly by Sky-Topo.

**Metric cadence:** RA Collector health metrics are collect-and-reset gauges published every 30s. Rate/increase queries are not appropriate for these; the panels display the raw value from the last collection cycle.

panels.description: PA Path Analytics connection status from the RA Collector agent health. 1=connected, 0=disconnected. GREEN means the gRPC stream to Crosswork is active. RED means the collector cannot reach PA – expand the RA Collector Connectivity row.
panels.title: 1 · RA Collector (edge)

panels.description: Events the RA Collector successfully sent to the Data Gateway (Roadrunner) in the last collection cycle. GREEN = data flowing from edge. RED (0) = RA connected but not sending – check RA Collector Processing row.
panels.title: 2 · RA → Roadrunner

panels.description: Files/batches the Sensor Collector (Roadrunner) delivered to Fedex in the last 5m. GREEN = data moving. RED (0) = no files delivered.
panels.title: 3 · Roadrunner → Fedex

panels.description: Records Fedex wrote to skytopo_raw_in Kafka topics in the last 5m (ra_summary + ra_instance). GREEN = flowing. RED (0) while stage 3 is green = data stalled at Fedex.
panels.title: 4 · Fedex → Kafka

panels.description: Records Sky-Topo processed from Kafka in the last 5m. GREEN = topology processing active. RED (0) while stage 4 is green = Sky-Topo stalled. GREY = metric unavailable.
panels.title: 5 · Sky-Topo

panels.description: Ingestion requests Gather successfully submitted to Druid in the last 5m. GREEN = flowing. RED (0) while stage 5 is green = Gather/Druid ingestion stalled.
panels.title: 6 · Gather → Druid

panels.description: Per-collector status table. Each row is one RA collector showing connectivity, configuration, and health.
panels.title: Collector Status

panels.description: Topology events consumed from PA vs successfully sent to Roadrunner per 30s cycle. A growing gap means events are being dropped (check whitelist/duplicate panels).
panels.title: RA Collector – Events Consumed vs Sent

panels.description: Events filtered out: unprovisioned (not in whitelist) and duplicated (same data already sent). High unprovisioned count means the connector config doesn't match the PA topology.
panels.title: RA Collector – Whitelist & Duplicate Drops

panels.description: Events that triggered aggregation and the time spent per reduction. High aggregation time may indicate performance bottleneck.
panels.title: RA Collector – Aggregation

panels.description: Configured update cadence in seconds. This controls how frequently the collector sends batches.
panels.title: RA Collector – Update Cadence

panels.description: Average time to read events from the gRPC stream per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Event Read Time

panels.description: Average time to process a segment per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Segment Processing Time

panels.description: Average time to process a full batch per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Batch Processing Time

panels.description: Average SQLite persistence time per 30s cycle. High values indicate disk I/O pressure.
panels.title: RA Collector – Persistence Usage

panels.description: Number of segments processed per 30s cycle.
panels.title: RA Collector – Segments Processed

panels.description: File processing rate and record count by objectType from Roadrunner.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Throughput

panels.description: Roadrunner connection status to PCA platform.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Connection to PCA

panels.description: Cached files and available batches in Roadrunner persistence. Growing backlog = downstream (Fedex) not consuming fast enough.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Persistence Cache Backlog

panels.description: Data dropped by Roadrunner, broken down by reason.
panels.title: Sensor Collector – Dropped Data (by reason)

panels.description: Records received by Fedex by objectType (ra_summary, ra_instance).
panels.title: Fedex – Records In (from Sensor Collectors)

panels.description: Messages Fedex produced to Kafka skytopo_raw_in topics.
panels.title: Fedex → Kafka Produced (msgs/s)

panels.description: Kafka producer errors from Fedex. Non-zero = data loss risk.
panels.title: Fedex – Kafka Produce Errors

panels.description: Batches rejected by Fedex due to unauthorized tenant, bad data, or internal errors.
panels.title: Fedex – Rejected Batches (by cause)

panels.description: Websocket teardowns and rejections between Roadrunner and Fedex.
panels.title: Fedex – Sensor Collector Websocket Issues

panels.description: Topology records processed by Sky-Topo from Kafka.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Records Processed

panels.description: Processing errors in Sky-Topo. Non-zero = topology data may be lost or corrupted.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Errors

panels.description: Current provisioned nodes vs maximum allowed. Hitting the max means new topology nodes will be rejected.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Current Nodes vs Max

panels.description: Average time to provision a new topology node.
panels.title: Sky-Topo – Node Provisioning Duration

panels.description: Number of RA collector agents available for segment assignment.
panels.title: Available RA Agents

panels.description: Total number of discovered topology segments.
panels.title: Total Segments

panels.description: Target number of segments each RA agent should handle.
panels.title: Target Segments/Agent

panels.description: Segments not assigned to any RA agent. Non-zero means some topology is not being monitored.
panels.title: Unassigned Segments

panels.description: Ingestion requests Gather has read, by changeType.
panels.title: Gather – Ingest Requests Read (APPEND/REFRESH)

panels.description: Druid ingestion submissions: success vs failure.
panels.title: Gather – Submit Success vs Fail

panels.description: Pacemaker queue depth. Growing queue = Druid not keeping up.
panels.title: Gather – Pacemaker Queue Size

panels.description: Available Druid middlemanager task slots. 0 = all slots busy, new ingestion tasks will queue.
panels.title: Druid – Middlemanager Slot Availability

panels.description: Druid tasks exceeding expected duration (refresh > 30min, delta > 5min).
panels.title: Druid – Tasks Taking Too Long

title: Path Analytics Ingestion Pipeline
